English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. The English query did not identify a qualifying institute, commitment, proposal or institute-specific study. The ministry's primary governance page assigns notifying functions to the Innovation Agency and market surveillance and contact functions to RRT. The broader query returned LitAI infrastructure and AI-governance project excerpts; neither snippet establishes an evaluator of advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged. The ministry passages were read through the web reader on 17 October 2026, despite separate complete-copy preservation failures.

News search from 17 October 2026 in English and Lithuanian, with the economy and innovation ministry's news page (newest 9 November). Left for review: the ministry's confirmation that the Seimas adopted the AI Act implementation law on 5 November, with commencement announced for 1 December. The promulgated act and its article-level allocations were not read, and adoption is not yet commencement. No national model evaluator was found. Partial check, not a full record re-check.

Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The ministry describes the Innovation Agency and Communications Regulatory Authority's AI Act functions; this is substantive national governance evidence.
